title: 第11章 女主的机缘？
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
是的，和陆沉这些日子的相处，她愈发觉得陆沉是一个正人君子。

    他永远会和自己保持距离，永远都不会逾矩一步，但这反而让自己对他的好感更多了。

    又过了几天，发现陆沉还是没有现身的庄静白急了。

    她不知道自己怎么了，就是有些想见陆沉。

    看着自己手中，林天送给自己的宝物，她咬了咬牙。

    “不行，我得去看看他。”

    她给自己找了个合适的理由。

    林天在禁地得了这种宝贝，正好拿去给陆沉赔罪，毕竟当初是林天和自己都犯糊涂了。

    随即，庄静白便找到了林天。

    “啊？娘子你要把那个能开第二个词条的宝物赔给他？”林天有些心疼。

    “太贵重了吧？”

    “你把人打晕扔洞房里的时候，怎么那么心安理得，没发现人陆沉这些日子都没来找过你吗？”

    “还有我，当初绑了人家，于情于理都要赔个不是……”

    林天讪讪闭嘴。

    很快，两人御剑落在陆沉洞府门口。

    “师弟！开门！我和你嫂子来看你了！”

    洞府内，陆沉刚醒酒不久，正盘膝调息。

    听到林天的声音，他睁开眼，下意识看了一眼客房的方向。

    客房的门紧闭着。

    他深吸一口气，起身去开门。

    “师兄，嫂子，你们怎么来了？”陆沉让开身位，请两人进来。

    庄静白一进门，目光便不着痕迹地扫过洞府内部。

    干净，太干净了，没想到陆沉对自己的生活环境这么在意。

    她心里默默给陆沉加了几分。

    “师弟，你这儿……”林天也愣住了。

    “怎么变样了？请人了？”

    陆沉心里一紧，面上却镇定道：“自己收拾的。闭关出来看着乱，就动手整理了一下。”

    “你自己？”林天挠头。

    “你什么时候这么勤快了？还铺了地板，养起花儿了？”

    听了这话，庄静白的眼底闪过一丝警惕。

    原来，这是最近才打理出来的。

    “坐吧。”陆沉引两人到桌边坐下，给两人倒茶。

    “师兄，你们今天来是……”

    林天从怀里掏出一个小盒子，往桌上一放。

    “师弟，这是给你的。”

    陆沉打开一看，愣住了。

    盒子里是一枚晶莹剔透的玉牌，上面刻着繁复的纹路，隐隐有灵光流转。

    “这是……”

    “我在禁地得的机缘，能给人再开一个词条。”

    陆沉手一抖，差点把盒子扔了。
content_en:
Yes, after getting along with Lu Chen these days, she felt more and more that Lu Chen was a gentleman.

He will always keep a distance from himself and will never go beyond the rules, but this only makes him like him even more.

A few days later, Zhuang Jing became anxious when she discovered that Lu Chen still hadn't shown up.

She didn't know what was wrong with her, but she just wanted to see Lu Chen.

Looking at the treasure Lin Tian gave her in her hand, she gritted her teeth.

"No, I have to go see him."

She found a suitable reason for herself.

Lin Tian got this kind of treasure in the forbidden area, and he just used it to make amends to Lu Chen. After all, it was Lin Tian and himself who were confused in the first place.

Immediately, Zhuang Jingbai found Lin Tian.

"Ah? Madam, are you going to give him the treasure that can open the second entry?" Lin Tian felt a little distressed.

"Isn't it too expensive?"

"When you knocked someone unconscious and threw him into the bridal chamber, how could you feel so at ease? Didn't you realize that Lu Chen hadn't come to see you these days?"

"And I, when I kidnapped someone, I have to apologize both emotionally and rationally..."

Lin Tianshan shut up.

Soon, the swords of the two men landed at the entrance of Lu Shen Cave Mansion.

"Junior brother! Open the door! Your sister-in-law and I are here to see you!"

In the cave, Lu Chen had just sobered up and was sitting cross-legged and adjusting his breathing.

Hearing Lin Tian's voice, he opened his eyes and subconsciously glanced in the direction of the guest room.

The door to the guest room was closed.

He took a deep breath and stood up to open the door.

"Brother, sister-in-law, why are you here?" Lu Chen stepped aside and invited the two of them to come in.

As soon as Zhuang Jingbai entered the door, his eyes swept through the interior of the cave without leaving any trace.

Clean, so clean. I didn't expect Lu Chen to care so much about his living environment.

She silently gave Lu Chen a few points in her heart.

"Junior brother, here you are..." Lin Tian was also stunned.

"Why has it changed? Did you invite someone?"

Lu Chen's heart tightened, but he said calmly: "I cleaned it up myself. When I came out of seclusion and saw the mess, I started to tidy it up."

"Yourself?" Lin Tian scratched his head.

"Since when have you been so diligent? Have you even laid the floor and raised flowers?"

After hearing this, Zhuang Jingbai's eyes flashed with vigilance.

It turns out that this was taken care of recently.

"Sit down." Lu Chen led the two of them to sit down at the table and poured tea for them.

"Senior brother, you are here today..."

Lin Tian took out a small box from his arms and put it on the table.

"Junior brother, this is for you."

Lu Chen opened it and was stunned.

Inside the box is a crystal clear jade plaque with complex patterns engraved on it, and there is a faint aura flowing through it.

"This is..."

"The opportunity I got in the forbidden land can open another entry for others."

Lu Chen's hands shook and he almost threw the box away.
